crackles.note: A rater's agreement with themselves upper-bounds their agreement with any reference standard. If this is low, everything below it is noise.

wheeze.note: A rater's agreement with themselves upper-bounds their agreement with any reference standard. If this is low, everything below it is noise.

published_human_benchmark.Tzeng_2025_JMIR_AI: 7 senior physicians score 47.77% ICBHI on this corpus
published_human_benchmark.Aviles-Solis_2016: inter-observer kappa < 0.40 on detailed adventitious sounds

ceiling_implication.reading: Mean clinician-vs-ICBHI kappa = 0.151 (slight). A trained listener and the ICBHI annotation disagree substantially on the SAME cycles. This does NOT bound what a machine can do: N11 fits a supervised probe on a frozen AudioSet embedding - a network that never saw a respiratory corpus - and reaches AUROC 0.71 (crackle) / 0.76 (wheeze) on the same test cycles, well above the 0.65 gate. The finding is therefore the sharper one: models reproduce these labels far better than a trained physician agrees with them. Our G2 extractors were weak; the reference standard was not the binding constraint.

release_asset.why: Gate G0 in the roadmap named the annotated subset as the project's ceiling lever - the first fine-grained concept annotations released for ICBHI.

corrections_written.limitation: each patient contributes only the 1-3 cycles sampled into the pack, out of ~60 in their record - a sparse correction, not a re-labelling
